# Uffes Köp & Sälj: "Köpläge i pressade råvarubolaget"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Ulf talks through his recent losing trades. His long call on Meko kept falling after a weak Q3 report, while his short call on Swedbank fell back from an all-time high. For the coming week he expects Yubico to pull back after its capital markets day, because he thinks its 2030 targets do not justify the stock's run of about 250%. He picks Boliden as the long trade, expecting a rebound helped by the stronger dollar after the drop in metal prices. He also says India is the market to be in right now.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 YUBICO — Yubico | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Short trade for the coming week: expects a pullback after the capital markets day and a strong run on the Q3 report.

#### Reasoning

Host Ulf: the stock is up ~250% and spiked on Q3. The CMD gave no new buying trigger, and the 2030 targets (15-20% growth, 20% margin) still imply a high P/E in 2030. He expects a weaker trend after the spike but admits it could go the other way and that the targets may be conservative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management raises 2030 targets
- if the stock keeps rising after the CMD
- if the market re-rates the conservative targets

> *"På kort sikt, kommande vecka så tror jag att det kan bli lite rekylläge i Yubico efter Kapton."*

---

### 🟢 BOL — Boliden | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Long trade for the coming week: oversold after the commodity drop; a stronger USD should lift Q4.

#### Reasoning

Host Ulf: Boliden has fallen on the commodity decline, but metal prices are still at levels where miners earn well. The dollar is at about 10.20 and Boliden doesn't hedge, so this should show clearly in Q4. Copper in SEK is not so bad, and most mines report in SEK/EUR. He expects a rebound and expects it to beat Yubico.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices fall further short term
- if USD/SEK weakens significantly
- if copper prices in SEK decline

> *"Men jag tror den kan rekylera upp lite. I alla fall ska den gå bättre än Yubico, det är väl mitt case."*

---

### 🟠 MEKO — Meko | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Not recommended a third week, but Ulf finds ~600M cash flow vs a sub-3bn valuation appealing; one to monitor.

#### Reasoning

Host Ulf: two wrong calls in a row after a weak Q3 with lost market share. The CEO says the investment hump (double warehouses) is over, so capex should fall and cash flow after investments could be ~600M against a valuation under 3bn, though the company has debt. He admits he seems to be alone in this view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market share losses continue
- if investment levels do not decline
- if cash flow fails to reach ~600M

> *"Men det är ett bolag man ska bevaka."*

---
